name: Scope 1 GHG emissions
description: Direct emissions from sources the company owns or controls.
formula: sum(co2e_t) of current calculations in Scope 1

name: Scope 2 GHG emissions (location-based)
description: Indirect emissions from purchased electricity, heat, steam and cooling, using grid-average factors.
formula: sum(co2e_t) of current calculations in Scope 2

name: Scope 3 GHG emissions
description: Other indirect emissions in the value chain.
formula: sum(co2e_t) of current calculations in Scope 3

name: Total GHG emissions (Scopes 1-3)
description: Sum of Scope 1, 2 and 3.

name: Total energy consumption
description: Electricity, purchased heat/steam/cooling, fuels (converted with the matched factor's net calorific value) and on-site renewable generation.

name: Renewable energy share
description: On-site renewable generation as a share of total energy.

name: Energy intensity
description: Total energy divided by a user-defined denominator (employees, tonnes of production, units of production or revenue).

name: Water withdrawal
description: Water taken from groundwater, municipal supply, surface water, rainwater and other sources.

name: Water discharge
description: Effluent and other water returned to the environment or third parties.

name: Water consumption
description: Withdrawal minus discharge, only for facility-months where both are reported.

name: Total waste generated
description: All waste leaving the facilities.

name: Hazardous waste
description: Waste marked hazardous.

name: Waste diverted to reuse, recycling or composting
description: Waste sent to reuse, recycling or composting.
formula: sum(t) where treatment in (Reuse, Recycling, Composting)

name: Recycling rate
description: Share of waste (by mass) sent to reuse, recycling or composting.

name: Average headcount
description: Mean of monthly total headcount over the period.

name: New hires
description: Employees hired in the period.

name: Employee turnover rate
description: Departures in the period divided by average headcount.

name: Training hours per employee
description: Training hours divided by average headcount.

name: Hours worked
description: Working hours plus overtime hours.

name: Lost-time injuries
description: Injury or fatality incidents that caused lost time.
formula: count(incidents where type in (injury, fatality) and lost_time)

name: Lost-time injury frequency rate
description: Lost-time injuries per million hours worked. The multiplier is configurable (1,000,000 is common internationally; some schemes use 200,000).

name: Recordable injury frequency rate
description: Injury and fatality incidents per million hours worked.

name: Work-related fatalities
description: Fatalities from work-related incidents.

name: Lost days
description: Days lost to work-related incidents.
